data.heading: A made-up estimate of household income

data.modelled: This figure is made up. A real one is an estimate from a model, and no count of what anybody has, and says so here.
notes: It is an average for the area: a mean, and not a median. It is not what any one household or person here has.
A real estimate quotes here what its publisher says of the limits round it.
It is of one year. Burro shows no change over time.
Nothing stands beside the figure: no other area, and no figure for the whole city. Burro says nothing about what it means.
